name: APIXDocumentReference
title: APIX Regulatory DocumentReference (base64 only)
description: DocumentReference profile used in APIX regulatory submissions. All documents are fully embedded as base64 (no external URLs allowed) and categorized with CTD section headings.

element.short: Unique permanent identifier for this document version
element.description: Business identifier that remains constant across all versions (typically a UUID). Required for traceability in regulatory submissions.
In APIX regulatory submissions, all submitted documents are considered current at time of submission.
Coded representation of the CTD section to which this document belongs. Binding is required to the APIX CTD section value set.

element.short: Date/time this document version was created
element.description: The date and time this DocumentReference metadata record was created for the submission. This represents the 'submission timestamp' of the document to the APIX exchange.

element.short: Single content element (APIX allows only one attachment per document)
element.description: Regulatory submissions require exactly one attachment per DocumentReference.

element.short: The actual document content and metadata
element.description: Contains the embedded document and its associated metadata.

element.short: MIME type of the document (e.g. application/pdf)
element.description: Official MIME type of the embedded document. Required for correct processing.
Full descriptive name of the file as it should appear in the submission (e.g. '3.2.S.1 - General Information - Drug Substance X.pdf').
The date and time the original document file (PDF, XML, etc.) was authored or generated. This represents the 'file age' and may be earlier than the submission date.
The full document is embedded inline as base64. This is mandatory in APIX; external references are not permitted.
APIX regulatory submissions do not allow external document references. All documents must be embedded using the 'data' element.

element.short: Size of the base64-encoded data in bytes
element.description: Optional but recommended: exact size of the embedded document for validation and integrity checking.

element.short: SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash of the original document
element.description: Optional cryptographic hash used for integrity verification of the embedded document.
